physics.comment: Hidden coupling the grader uses. mwPerHz governs how a steady-state MW imbalance maps to a frequency deviation from nominal (load-damping + droop, lumped). A 30 MW net shortfall ~= -0.1 Hz here.

_doc: Hidden truth lives in `truth` + the per-variant `variants` block and the settle grader. The forecast/asset_status observe tools surface WARNING SIGNS (renewable dip in the forecast, a derate/condition flag on the unit that will trip) but never state the outage timing or the winning reserve plan — that is what a successful episode teaches.

truth.comment: The event that fires when settle_interval is called. trippedAsset loses outageMw; renewables lose renewableDipMw at the same instant. The agent must pre-position enough committed, dispatchable reserve to cover (outageMw + renewableDipMw) net of any ramp headroom, and run 'follow' so the reserve actually responds. Shedding load relieves the deficit but is penalized as a last resort.
